From 22 November the relief camp at Bahadurpur Middle School has moved to Laheriasarai Town Hall, near Laheriasarai railway station. Free tempo from Bahadurpur school gate every 2 hours, 8 am to 6 pm.
The winter blanket and dry ration drive is extended from 30 November to 15 December. We still need 2,000 blankets.

Camp move: families registered at Bahadurpur, until 30 November (tempo).
Donation drive: donors, until 15 December.
